teaser: A radio left on in the next room, turned low, still finding its way through the wall — that's close to what sits between a life path 3 and an ENFJ, something meant for a room other than the one it started in. The 3 carries an appetite for expression, a voice that wants to travel. The ENFJ carries an appetite for an audience that grows, that does well because of the attention it receives. Crossed, the warmth a voice makes rarely stays where it started: it goes looking for somewhere to land, someone to lift, before you have finished deciding what you meant to say. Expression turns into attention to a room, almost before it finishes being expression at all.
